[Runtime] Expose kernel argument layout (#12158)

Expose a driver-independent helper that maps kernel arguments to their
source paths and physical parameter types, including nested arguments
and tensor descriptors.

Reuse it in the CUDA and HIP launchers, removing duplicated signature
flattening and unused argument setup.

commits.comment: AMD assert 修复：原先 AMD 的 assertFail 在 per-thread if(failed) 块内同时执行 printf 和 s_trap，并在中间插入 barrier，导致只有失败 lane 的 wave 才会到达该 barrier；由于 AMD s_barrier 实例不可区分，这会与通过 wave 的 post-assert barrier 错误配对，可能造成死锁或行为异常。本 commit 在 include/triton/Conversion/TritonGPUToLLVM/TargetInfoBase.h 新增纯虚 assertTrap(rewriter, loc) 与带默认 false 的 requiresAssertTrap()；共享 AssertOpToLLVM.cpp 现在：先在 per-thread 条件下 llAssert 打印，若条件为 RankedTensorType 或 requiresAssertTrap() 则插入 block barrier（统一由所有线程到达），随后在相同条件下用 createIfBlock 新建块调用 assertTrap。AMD TargetInfo 实现 requiresAssertTrap()=true 并抽出 assertTrap（只做 s_trap 2，不再包含 barrier），assertFail 只保留 printf 调用；NVIDIA 实现 requiresAssertTrap()=false（继承默认），assertTrap 用 llvm_unreachable 兜底（因为 __assertfail 自身会 abort）。AMD lit 测试新增 assert_tensor / assert_scalar 用例，用 COMMON-NOT/COMMON-NEXT 严格校验『print 块内无 barrier/s_trap、join 处 barrier 后才 trap』的顺序。风险：assertTrap 是新的纯虚方法，任何 TargetInfoBase 的具体子类必须实现，否则编译失败（NVIDIA 已实现；若不使用 TargetInfoBase 的后端如 Ascend 不受影响）。语义上 barrier 的插入位置变化会影响 assert 后续代码的收敛行为，需注意 ConSan 锁释放路径（commit 说明中已明确处理 llvm.trap 的 noreturn 问题）。

ascend_impact.functionality: 无影响。变更涉及 include/triton/Conversion/TritonGPUToLLVM/TargetInfoBase.h 与 lib/Conversion/TritonGPUToLLVM/AssertOpToLLVM.cpp，按架构规则 TargetInfoBase 及其 lowering 路径属于 triton-ascend 完全不使用的部分（Ascend 走 TritonToLinalg，不实现也不调用 TargetInfoBase，不做 TritonGPU→LLVM lowering）。AMD/NVIDIA 的 TargetInfo 实现为平台特定代码。assertTrap 是纯虚新增，但只有当某后端继承 TargetInfoBase 并实例化时才需要实现，Ascend 无此路径，因此不会产生编译或运行问题。

commits.message:
[AMD] Move assert barrier out of divergent control flow (#12166)

The AMD assertFail lowering emitted a block barrier inside the
per-thread `if (failed)` block so that all failing waves finish printing
before any of them traps. For tensor conditions that barrier is reached
only by waves with a failing lane, and only pairs with the passing
waves' post-assert barrier because AMD s_barrier instances are
indistinguishable.

Split the abort out of assertFail into a new
`TargetInfoBase::assertTrap` hook, gated by `requiresAssertTrap()`. The
shared AssertOp lowering now prints under the per-thread condition,
executes a uniform barrier, and then traps under the same condition.
NVIDIA is unchanged since `__assertfail` aborts on its own.

commits.comment: AMD NFC 重构：把 TritonAMDGPUToLLVM/Utility.h 中的 upcast8xMxfp4_HW、upcast4xMxfp8_HW、upcast8xMxfp8fp4_HW 三个模板（仅被 scaled upcast lowering 使用）搬进 TritonAMDGPUDialectToLLVM/ScaledUpcastToLLVM.cpp，并新增 packI8x4ToI32 / scaleExponentToF32 / unpackPairs 三个 helper 去重三个模板中重复的字节打包、指数缩放与结果解包逻辑；同时把返回值语义统一为『已解包的标量结果数组』（此前 upcast8xMxfp4_HW/upcast4xMxfp8_HW 返回 packed pair，由调用点自行 bitcast+extract_element），调用点相应简化为 results.append(converted.begin(), converted.end()).getLength。这是纯代码搬移与去重，作者声明 gfx942/gfx950/gfx1250 上 scaled upcast、scaled downcast、fp_to_fp lit 测试 IR 不变。风险：模板由返回 packed 变为返回 unpacked，若未来有其他调用点（如 dot_scaled 之外的路径）仍按旧语义使用需注意，但本 commit 已改全部调用点。

ascend_impact.testing: 无影响。AMD lit 测试的 FileCheck 结果预期不变，不需要 triton-ascend 侧同步。

commits.message:
[AMD] NFC: Move scaled upcast HW helpers out of Utility.h (#12164)

The upcast8xMxfp4_HW, upcast4xMxfp8_HW, and upcast8xMxfp8fp4_HW
templates in TritonAMDGPUToLLVM/Utility.h are only used by the scaled
upcast lowering, so move them into ScaledUpcastToLLVM.cpp.

While here, deduplicate the byte packing and exponent scale computation
shared by upcast8xMxfp4_HW and upcast4xMxfp8_HW, and have both return
the unpacked scalar results like upcast8xMxfp8fp4_HW does instead of
leaving that to each call site. The lowered IR for the scaled upcast,
scaled downcast, and fp_to_fp lit tests on gfx942, gfx950, and gfx1250
is unchanged.

commits.comment: AMD RDNA4 FP8 硬件 upcast：RDNA4（gfx1200/gfx1201）实现 v_cvt_pk_f32_fp8 且为 OCP E4M3FN 语义，但 Triton AMD lowering 此前只为 CDNA4/GFX1250 选择硬件路径（scaled 指令），导致 gfx1200 上 OCP E4M3FN upcast 退化为体积很大的软件解码。本 commit 新增 hasUnscaledOcpFp8Cvt(family) 返回 family==RDNA4m||RDNA4，并引入 UnscaledF8x4ToFp32<PkConvertOp, ConvertOp> 统一分派：FNUZ 目标走 PkF4ToFp32（packed cvt），OCP 目标走新的 F8x4ToFp32（逐字节 v_cvt_f32_fp8/bf8，因为 LLVM 生成的 packed upcast 形式会被 true16 汇编器拒绝）。Fp8E4M3fnuzToFp16HW/Bf16HW 与 Fp8E5M2fnuzToBf16HW 重命名为 Fp8E4M3ToFp16HW 等以反映其对 FNUZ/OCP 双语义的复用；Fp8→f16/bf16 路径在 CDNA4 之后再补一条 hasUnscaledOcpFp8Cvt 分支，f8→bf16 的精确性由 E4M3 三位尾数 < BF16 七位保证。测试侧在 test_conversions.py 放宽 float8e4nv upcast 的平台判定到 RDNA4m/RDNA4，并在 ocp_fp8_cvt_lowering.mlir 中把 gfx1200 从 NOHW 改为 HWCVT 前缀，新增对 upcast fp8→f16 走 rocdl.cvt.f32.fp8 + llvm.fptrunc、fp8→bf16 走 rocdl.cvt.f32.fp8/bf8 的计数断言。

commits.message:
[AMD] Use hardware OCP FP8 upcasts on RDNA4 (#11809)

RDNA4 implements `v_cvt_pk_f32_fp8` with OCP E4M3FN semantics, but
Triton's AMD lowering currently selects hardware paths only for CDNA4
and GFX1250. On gfx1200/gfx1201, OCP E4M3FN upcasts therefore fall back
to the much larger software decoder, including in inner loops that
upcast FP8 inputs before arithmetic.

Enable the packed hardware conversion for all three supported OCP E4M3FN
upcasts:

- FP8 -> FP32 uses the packed FP32 result directly.
- FP8 -> FP16 converts the packed FP32 result to FP16.
- FP8 -> BF16 converts the packed FP32 result to BF16. This leg is exact
  because E4M3 has three mantissa bits while BF16 has seven.

Fixes #11497.

commits.comment: Proton chrome trace 修复：当 CUDA graph 在 proton.start 之前创建（例如在 warmup 中捕获）时，其 kernel 记录在 graph launch op 之下，而该 launch op 没有 CPU 时间范围，导致 dumpChromeTrace 在查找 launch event 时抛出 'Cannot find CPU scope event for kernel launch event id'。修复方式是在 third_party/proton/csrc/lib/Data/TraceData.cpp 的 dumpChromeTrace 中查 launchEventId 对应 event，若存在但 !hasCpuTimeRange()，则把 launchEventId 置为 Trace::Event::DummyId，使该 kernel 不生成 launch 箭头（flow event），从而对本来能正常 dump 的场景零改动。测试层面把 test_cudagraph_not_captured_by_profiler 参数化为 data='tree'/'trace'，trace 分支校验 traceEvents 中每个 replay scope 下 kernel 数量 >=3、存在 dur>0 的 kernel，并断言没有任何 cat=='flow' 事件。风险低，属输出格式容错增强。

ascend_impact.functionality: 无影响。变更位于 third_party/proton 的 trace dump 逻辑与 Proton 测试，是 CUDA graph + profiling 的专属问题修复，triton-ascend 默认不使用 Proton，也不受 chrome trace 格式变更影响。

commits.message:
[PROTON] Fix chrome trace for graphs created before profiling starts (#12142)

Dumping a chrome trace throws `Cannot find CPU scope event for kernel
launch event id` when a CUDA graph was created before `proton.start`
(e.g. captured during warmup): its kernels are recorded under the graph
launch op, which has no CPU time range. Such kernels now get no launch
arrow, so dumps that work today are unchanged.

`test_cudagraph_not_captured_by_profiler` now also covers the trace
format.

commits.message:
[AMD] Use hardware cvt instructions for OCP fp8 casts on gfx1170 (#11486)

gfx1170 has `FeatureFP8ConversionInsts`, the `v_cvt_`, and `v_cvt_pk_'
instructions, and on that target they encode OCP fp8. Until now every
OCP fp8 cast on gfx1170 fell back to the software bit-manipulation path
anyway, because neither existing hardware path fit: CDNA4 and gfx1250
use the *scaled* ops (`v_cvt_scalef32_pk_*`), which gfx1170 does not
have, and the plain ops were wired only into the CDNA3 FNUZ converters,
the wrong fp8 flavor for gfx1170's E4M3FN/E5M2.

This PR routes `f8E4M3FN`/`f8E5M2` <-> `f32`/`f16`/`bf16` casts on
gfx1170 to the plain instructions.

commits.comment: 测试稳定性修复：test_is_lazy 通过 reload(triton.runtime.driver) 与 reload(triton.runtime) 验证 driver 延迟创建，但 reload 会构造第二个 DriverConfig 而不恢复原始的；由于 triton.compiler.compiler、triton.language.semantic、target_info 等模块在导入时按值绑定了第一个 driver 单例，此后同一 worker 进程中两个 config 并存且不一致，导致 patch 一个 config 对读另一个的代码不可见（具体表现为 test_get_dram_gbps_memory_data_rate 打桩 driver._active 后 get_dram_gbps 因函数内解析名字而读到真实设备，多个不同 fake 输入返回同一常量）。修复：在 try/finally 中保存原 driver_module.driver，finally 里恢复 driver_module.driver 与 triton.runtime.driver 两处，并新增断言 triton.runtime.driver is triton.compiler.compiler.driver 确保一致性。风险低，仅影响测试隔离性。

ascend_impact.functionality: 无影响。变更仅在 python/test/unit/runtime/test_driver.py，修复测试进程内 driver 单例隔离问题，不涉及任何 triton-ascend 需要实现或复用的接口。
ascend_impact.testing: 无影响。triton-ascend 若在测试中同样对 triton.runtime.driver 做 reload/importlib 操作，可参考此 finally 恢复模式避免单例分裂，但不需要因本 commit 修改自身测试。

commits.message:
[CI] Restore the driver singleton after test_is_lazy reloads it (#12161)

test_is_lazy reloads triton.runtime.driver and triton.runtime to prove the
driver is created lazily, but never puts the original DriverConfig back. The
reloads build a second one, and modules that imported the singleton by value
(triton.compiler.compiler, triton.language.semantic, target_info, and tests
doing the same) keep the first. For the rest of that worker process the two
disagree, so patching one config is invisible to code reading the other.

test_get_dram_gbps_memory_data_rate surfaces it: it patches driver._active
with fake device properties, but get_dram_gbps resolves the name inside
the function and so reads the real device. Two jobs on one commit, each
reporting a single constant for several different fake inputs:

  gfx942   assert 2662.4 == 322.048   (and 640.0, 64.0)
  gfx90a   assert 1638.4 == 863.232   (and 624.0, 288.0, 256.0)

2662.4 is MI300X and 1638.4 MI200, and the two jobs failed on disjoint
parameters, so all that matters is whether the worker ran test_is_lazy
first.

Restore the original on both the module and the package in a finally
block.
